question.text: \(\mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{CO}_3\) is prepared by Solvay process but \(\mathrm{K}_2 \mathrm{CO}_3\) cannot be prepared by the same because

solution.text:
Hint: \(\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right) \mathrm{HCO}_3+\mathrm{KCl} \longrightarrow \mathrm{KHCO}_3(\mathrm{aq})+\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{Cl}(\mathrm{aq})\)
\(\mathrm{KHCO}_3\) being appreciably soluble cant be isolated from reaction medium easily.
